note: Texts of the site that are not in a page when it loads: they appear only after the visitor does something (sends
the form, opens the inquiry panel, enters V-TECH from the home page). site-text-export.cjs cannot see them and the
lead form is never submitted in a test, so they are listed here word for word from the code. site-text-xlsx.py
checks that every fragment still stands in its file (a changed text stops the build) and reports any other Hebrew
text of the code that is neither on a page nor here. A placeholder in the text is written between ‹ and ›.
